scripts.build: pnpm run build:root && pnpm run build:packages
scripts.type-check: pnpm run type-check:cli && pnpm run type-check:tx-builder && pnpm run type-check:tx-generator && pnpm run type-check:scalability-harness
scripts.tx:corpus:generate:benchmark-runs: mkdir -p packages/scalability-harness/corpora && pnpm --filter @midgard-manager/tx-generator run build && pnpm --filter @midgard-manager/tx-generator exec node dist/bin/index.js generate-corpus --test-wallet --network ${TX_CORPUS_NETWORK:-Preview} --type ${TX_CORPUS_TYPE:-one-to-one} --count ${TX_CORPUS_COUNT:-1500000} --seed ${TX_CORPUS_SEED:-benchmark-runs-corpus} --output ${TX_CORPUS_OUTPUT:-$PWD/packages/scalability-harness/corpora/corpus-v1-net-preview-t-one-to-one-r-na-n-1500000.jsonl} --progress-interval ${TX_CORPUS_PROGRESS_INTERVAL:-10000} --progress-interval-ms ${TX_CORPUS_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_MS:-1000}
scripts.node:clear:all: pnpm run node:clear:mempool && pnpm run node:clear:submit-blocks && pnpm run node:reset:postgres && pnpm run node:reset:auto
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:unit:tx-builder && pnpm run test:unit:tx-generator && pnpm run test:unit:scalability-harness
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run test:integration:tx-builder && pnpm run test:integration:scalability-harness
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
